content: अभिसंधिः .²1 Speech; deliberate declaration, promise. .²2 Intention, object, purpose, aim; दम्पत्योः प्राणसंश्लेषे योऽभिसंधिः कृतः किल <ls>Mb. 12. 266. 34</ls>; तस्या आभिसंधिना विधेयीकृतोऽपि <ls>Māl. 1</ls>; <ls>Dk. 38</ls>; स्वर्ग˚ <ls>Ku. 6. 47</ls>. .²3 Implied sense, the meaning intended, as in अयमभिसन्धिः (frequently occurring in explanatory glosses). .²4 Opinion, belief. .²5 Special agreement, terms of an agreement, condition, stipulation; अथावश्यमेव माधवसेनः पूज्येन मोचयितव्यः श्रूयतामभिसन्धिः <ls>M. 1</ls>. .²6 Deception, Making peace or alliance. .²8 Junction, combination.
